edits.new:
The harness asserts these rules and changes none of them; the rules themselves are evaluated in RWB-S8-E7001-APP, the states and the timers are held by P3 rwb-case, the evidence pack is P5's, and the record is P7's.

Deviation rules: this story carries the R-DEV rules named in the feature tables and in BR1 to BR5, and takes R-DEV-19 (re-route) and R-DEV-21 (unmapped code to the team manager) from the design. Authoring of the rule package, its version label and its promotion to the rule registry stay in rwb-decision.

Reference data read by the run: the rule package in force and its parameters are read through the reference-data contract DP-06 and DP-07; the parameters are not specified in the source documents (DOR-RWB-ITG-E7001-ITG-20).
